policy: Every generated or licensed image shown inside a PrayogX experience page is listed here with its provenance (tools/visual_assets.py, docs/VISUAL_ASSETS.md). A page may embed only a listed asset whose licence is verified, permits commercial use on the web, Instagram and YouTube (reels record the page), and whose embedded bytes match the approved file's sha256. External providers need a licence document kept in the repository; none is configured yet. No asset is listed until one is approved.
